Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.sg.internal.wrapper

Interface ShaderAttributeValueWrapper

All Superinterfaces:
NodeComponentWrapper, SceneGraphObjectWrapper, ShaderAttributeObjectWrapper, ShaderAttributeWrapper
All Known Implementing Classes:
ShaderAttributeValue
public interface ShaderAttributeValueWrapper extends ShaderAttributeObjectWrapper
The ShaderAttributeValueWrapper object encapsulates a uniform shader attribute whose value is specified explicitly. The shader variable attrName is explicitly set to the specified value during rendering. attrName must be the name of a valid uniform attribute in the shader in which it is used. Otherwise, the attribute name will be ignored and a runtime error may be generated. The value must be an instance of one of the allowed classes. The allowed classes are: Integer, Float, Double, Tuple{2,3,4}{i,f,d}, Matrix{3,4}{f,d}. A ClassCastException will be thrown if a specified value object is not one of the allowed types. Further, the type of the value is immutable once a ShaderAttributeValueWrapper is constructed. Subsequent setValue operations must be called with an object of the same type as the one that was used to construct the ShaderAttributeValueWrapper. Finally, the type of the value object must match the type of the corresponding attrName variable in the shader in which it is used. Otherwise, the shader will not be able to use the attribute and a runtime error may be generated.
